'''''P2''''' was one of three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] that was sent by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] to reinforce [[Phoenix Cell]], a rebel unit led by [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]].<ref name="Princess on Lothal" /> Easily identified by its [[Color|red]] markings,<ref name="APOL Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-episode-guide|text="A Princess on Lothal" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> ''P2'' and its sister ships ''[[P1]]'' and ''[[P3]]'' arrived to the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] under the leadership of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] disguised as ships partaking in a relief mission for the battered Lothal citizenry. The [[Galactic Empire]], who was in control of the planet, suspected a possible rebel theft, however, and attempted to lock the ships down. Despite their efforts, the rebel [[Spectres]] group managed to hijack ''P2'' and the other [[corvette]]s and bring them back to Phoenix Squadron. ''P2'' flew with the Phoenix Squadron fleet on a number of occasions, and provided support when necessary. During the [[Standard year|year]] [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> ''P2'' participated in a [[Battle of Atollon|battle]] that took place over the planet [[Atollon]], where it was engaged with [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Imperial forces]] led by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. Along with many rebel and Imperial ships, ''P2'' was destroyed in the conflict.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''P2'' first appeared in "[[A Princess on Lothal]]," the mid-season premier of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', and first identified on the corresponding episode guide on [[StarWars.com]], along with ''[[P1]]'' and ''[[P3]]''.<ref name="APOL Episode Guide" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' identifies the three corvettes as ''[[Lightmaker]]'', ''Duchess Senna'', and ''Amity's Arrow'',<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> although it has not been clarified which names corresponds to the ships. However, ''P2''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s destruction at the Battle of Atollon<ref name="Zero Hour" /> means it cannot be the ''Lightmaker'', as that ship appears in the later-set ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' fighting in the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
